# Wagepan: Exact Match {#sec-wagepan}

**Data:** `wagepan` — 545 workers, 8 years (1980–1987).  
**Outcome:** `lwage`. **Treatment:** `union` (binary).

---

## IV.01 — Binary Treatment: `union` {#sec-iv01}

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Stata

```stata
ssc install did_multiplegt_stat, replace
ssc install bcuse, replace
bcuse wagepan, clear

did_multiplegt_stat lwage nr year union, estimator(was) exact_match placebo(1)
```


### Python

```python
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import numpy as np
import wooldridge
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat

wagepan = wooldridge.data("wagepan")

m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["waoss"], exact_match=True, placebo=1, asinstata=True)
m.fit(wagepan, Y="lwage", ID="nr", Time="year", D="union")
m.summary()
```


## IV.02 — Discrete Treatment: `dis_u` {#sec-iv02}

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Stata

```stata
ssc install did_multiplegt_stat, replace
ssc install bcuse, replace
bcuse wagepan, clear

set seed 12345
gen dis_u = runiformint(1, 5) + union
gen lwage2 = lwage + 3*dis_u
did_multiplegt_stat lwage2 nr year dis_u, estimator(was as) exact_match placebo(1)
```

### Python

```python
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import numpy as np
import wooldridge
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat

wagepan = wooldridge.data("wagepan")

rng = np.random.default_rng(12345)
wagepan2 = wagepan.copy()
wagepan2["dis_u"]  = rng.integers(1, 6, size=len(wagepan)) + wagepan["union"]
wagepan2["lwage2"] = wagepan["lwage"] + 3 * wagepan2["dis_u"]

m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["waoss","aoss"], exact_match=True, placebo=1, asinstata=True)
m.fit(wagepan2, Y="lwage2", ID="nr", Time="year", D="dis_u")
m.summary()
```


## IV.03 — IV-WAS with Exact Match {#sec-iv03}

```python
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import numpy as np
import wooldridge

wagepan = wooldridge.data("wagepan")

rng = np.random.default_rng(12345)
wagepan2 = wagepan.copy()
wagepan2["dis_u"]  = rng.integers(1, 6, size=len(wagepan)) + wagepan["union"]
wagepan2["lwage2"] = wagepan["lwage"] + 3 * wagepan2["dis_u"]

m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["ivwaoss"], exact_match=True, placebo=1, asinstata=True)
m.fit(wagepan2, Y="lwage2", ID="nr", Time="year", D="dis_u", Z="union")
m.summary()
```

## IV.04 — Other Treatments {#sec-iv04}

```python
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import numpy as np
import wooldridge
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat

wagepan = wooldridge.data("wagepan")

wagepan3 = wagepan.copy()
wagepan3["othertreat"]  = (wagepan["lwage"] > 1.5).astype(int)
wagepan3["othertreat2"] = ((wagepan["lwage"] < 1) | (wagepan["lwage"] > 2)).astype(int)

m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["waoss"], exact_match=True, placebo=1,
                       other_treatments=["othertreat","othertreat2"], asinstata=True)
m.fit(wagepan3, Y="lwage", ID="nr", Time="year", D="union")
m.summary()
```

```
-----------------------------------
N                =              545
WAOSS Method     =  Reg. Adjustment
Common Support   =   Exact Matching
-----------------------------------
```
